read.thesis: UPS is deliberately shrinking low-margin Amazon volume (down 16% in Q1, ~30% in H2) and cutting $3.5B cost in 2025, but withheld full-year guidance and Q2 U.S. ADV is guided down 9%.

utilisation.quote: 64% of volume now processed through automated hubs, up 4.5% year over year

triggers.label: 164 closures, 73 buildings by June
triggers.quote: we will complete 164 operational closures, including 73 building closures by the end of June

triggers.label: Revenue per piece up 4.5%
triggers.quote: revenue per piece increased 4.5% year-over-year, which was the strongest revenue per piece growth rate we've seen in eight quarters
triggers.highlight: strongest revenue per piece growth rate we've seen in eight quarters

triggers.label: U.S. ADV guided down about 9% in Q2
triggers.quote: in the second quarter, we expect ADV to be down about 9% and revenue to be down low single digits

triggers.label: No full-year outlook update
triggers.quote: we are not providing any updates to our consolidated full year outlook at this time
triggers.highlight: not providing any updates to our consolidated full year outlook

triggers.label: Customers drawing down inventory
triggers.quote: they're letting inventory levels sell-off, which will lead to lower shipping activity, at least for now

guidance.quote: we expect ADV to be down about 9% and revenue to be down low single digits

guidance.metric: U.S. Domestic operating margin change Q2
guidance.quote: We expect the U.S. Domestic operating margin to expand by approximately 30 basis points
we expect revenue to be down approximately 2% to last year and operating margin to be in the mid-teens
is expected to remove $3.5 billion in expense this year
we are not providing any updates to our consolidated full year outlook at this time

red_flags.label: Withheld full-year guidance
red_flags.quote: we are not providing any updates to our consolidated full year outlook at this time

red_flags.label: Q2 chaos costs from closures
red_flags.quote: we have built in some chaos costs in order to manage the volume and maintain service

evasions.quote: given today's level of uncertainty, however, we are not providing any updates to our consolidated full year outlook

evasions.topic: Cost savings vs Amazon revenue loss
evasions.quote: we are making structural changes to the business to improve the margin
